en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.title: 21 factories in Savar close under no-work, no-pay rule
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: Twenty-one factories in Savar and Ashulia have suspended operations under Section 13(1) of the Labour Act, resulting in a no-work, no-pay status for employees. While the closures occur amid ongoing worker wage protests, officials report that many factories are continuing production peacefully despite the notices. Law enforcement has been deployed to ensure order in the industrial area.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.title: Government plans Tk 1.25 trillion Dhaka–Chattogram expressway
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: The government intends to transform the Dhaka–Chattogram highway into a 233-kilometre access-controlled expressway to reduce travel time to three hours. The Tk 1.25 trillion project, which aims for completion by 2032, would feature six high-speed lanes and separate roads for local traffic. A final decision remains pending approval from the Prime Minister.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.title: Vehicles set on fire and banks attacked in two districts
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: Two buses were set ablaze in Manikganj and Narayanganj on Saturday night, while petrol bombs were hurled at two Grameen Bank branches in Madaripur. Additionally, authorities in Natore recovered six abandoned crude bombs. Police and fire services are investigating the incidents amid ongoing reports of sabotage.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.title: Government sets 2031 goal for SME growth and job creation
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has announced plans to develop 25,000 new entrepreneurs and generate 2.5 million jobs in the small and medium enterprise sector by 2031. Speaking at the 13th National SME Products Fair, the Prime Minister emphasized that increasing support for these industries is essential for Bangladesh’s economic prosperity and self-reliance.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/business/lo.title: Proposed reforms to restrict politicians from private bank boards
en|https://en.prothomalo.com/business/lo.summary: The government is drafting an amendment to the Bank Company Act to prohibit ministers, MPs, and local representatives from serving on private bank boards. The reforms also aim to curb familial dominance by reducing the number of directors allowed from one family. These measures seek to improve banking governance and protect depositor interests.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/.summary: The National Citizen Party (NCP) has accepted an invitation from Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to discuss national unity. A four-member delegation, led by Nahid Islam, will meet the Prime Minister on Monday. This dialogue marks the start of government discussions with political parties that participated in the July mass uprising.

en|https://en.prothomalo.com/opinion/op-.summary: The banned Awami League party faces significant obstacles to returning to politics following accusations of authoritarianism and recent violent acts across the country. Intelligence reports suggest that the party is utilizing violence to demonstrate political strength, leading to attacks on infrastructure and political opponents, which complicates its potential path back to legitimate political engagement.

en|https://www.dw.com/en/cop31-climate-d.summary: The UN's COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, concluded without a joint declaration after nations failed to reach a consensus.
